question: Should phase-one preview behavior extend `builtin:iframe-embed`, or should Workspaces permanently expose a separate `builtin:preview` contract now for the planned privileged preview phases?
rationale: The current phase duplicates the existing embed capability, while the roadmap anticipates later process, console, network, and screenshot capabilities that may justify a distinct trusted kind; only maintainers can select the durable public widget contract.

options.title: Extend iframe embed
options.body: Add typed reload and viewport controls to the existing embed kind, avoiding a parallel phase-one contract and future policy drift.

options.title: Keep preview distinct
options.body: Approve a separate preview kind now and document and test the permanent distinction and upgrade contract before merge.

options.title: Pause preview surface
options.body: Defer the new kind until privileged dev-server or browser-backed capability is ready to justify the separate contract.

recommendation.title: Extend iframe embed
recommendation.body: Add typed reload and viewport controls to the existing embed kind, avoiding a parallel phase-one contract and future policy drift.

likelyOwner.reason: They integrated the current Workspaces foundation and are the strongest history-backed owner for its public widget contract.
